text:
maria: quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to update the model catalog entry and add a short migration guide for customers moving from the legacy `rwd-small` to `rwd-v2025` variant. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312
kevin: thanks — can you paste a 1-2 sentence release blurb here so I can include it in the changelog? i'll run the docs preview after that.
maria: sure — draft blurb below:

maria: ```
Model catalog update: `rwd-small` is deprecated in favor of the improved `rwd-v2025` variant. `rwd-v2025` provides better latency and stability. See migration notes for tokenization changes and recommended quantization settings.
```
kevin: nice. running preview now. cc @sam for release timing.
ci-bot: docs-preview build #478 failed — linkcheck error: broken anchor in `migration.md` (line 42)
maria: ugh, thanks — i missed that anchor when moving sections. fixing now.
leo: also add a short SDK snippet showing the new model name so code examples don't break in the release notes.
maria: added SDK snippet in `migration.md`:`

maria: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="rwd-v2025", prompt="Summarize...")
```
kevin: LGTM on content. once CI passes i'll give final review.
ci-bot: docs-preview build #479 passed — preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/builds/479
sam: timing note — we have a quiet patch window at 10:30 PT today. if this is merged before 10:20 PT I'll include it in tonight's release notes; otherwise we'll include it in the next minor.
maria: targeting 10:10 PT. will merge as soon as kevin gives final +1.
kevin: +1 from me. looks good. :+1:
leo: small nit — add a short migration step about updating embedding configs (one line). added a tiny commit.
maria: saw it, thanks. rebased and tests passing.
kevin: merging in 2m (watching for any last-second CI flakes).
ci-bot: merged PR #312 by maria into `main` — build #481 kicked off.
sam: thanks team — i'll add the blurb to the release notes under "Model catalog updates" and drop a short migration callout in the release email. :rocket:
kevin: great coordination — good example of quick docs + release flow.
leo: filing a tiny follow-up to add a short note for Dedicated customers on quant settings (ref: internal ticket #742).
maria: noted. thanks all.
